**Action:**
1.  Navigate to the "Job Management" portal and open the specific work order.
2.  Locate the "Compliance/Disclosures" section within the job file.
3.  Select the "Emissions Disclosure" field and update the status to "Declined by Customer."
4.  In the "Notes/Comments" field, enter: "Customer declined emissions disclosure during phone consultation on [Current Date]. Verbal refusal noted."
5.  Change the "Review Status" from "Pending" to "Finalized/Completed."
6.  Save the record and confirm that the job status reflects as "Closed/Reviewed."
